evals.prompt:
Use $vercel-composition-patterns. Refactor this conceptual React API from boolean-prop branching into a more composable API, while preserving the user-visible behavior:

```tsx
<Dialog
  showHeader
  showFooter
  showCloseButton
  destructive
  onConfirm={deleteAccount}
/>
```

Give a migration sketch and explain why it scales better. Text only.
evals.expected_output: A React composition-pattern refactor using children, slots, or compound components instead of accumulating boolean flags.
expectations: The response identifies boolean-prop branching as the scalability problem.
The response proposes composition using children, slots, or compound components.
The response preserves or explicitly maps the existing header, footer, close, and destructive behavior.
The response includes a migration or compatibility path rather than an unexplained breaking rewrite.
